intro.heading: A little more about me
intro.text: I'm a product thinker and data storyteller based in India. I work at the intersection of analytics, operations, and customer experience — building tools and systems that turn ambiguity into clarity.

quickFacts: I've spent 5+ years working in analytics and product, primarily in e-commerce and logistics.
I'm passionate about building internal tools that save teams hours of manual work every week.
I believe the best dashboards tell a story — not just display numbers.
Outside of work, I'm usually reading, experimenting with side projects, or exploring new cities.
I care deeply about craft and getting the details right.
I think the best solutions come from understanding the problem deeply before writing any code.

entries.text: Started my career in analytics, learning the ropes of data pipelines, SQL, and how to translate business questions into actionable insights. Built my first dashboards and fell in love with the craft of data storytelling.

Moved into a product-adjacent role, working closely with operations teams to identify pain points and build solutions. This is where I learned that the best tools aren't the most complex — they're the ones people actually use.

Now focused on building end-to-end solutions — from identifying the problem, to designing the data architecture, to shipping the final product. I work across analytics, tooling, and process improvement, always with an eye on impact.
